title: Speed dependent descending control of freezing behavior in Drosophila melanogaster
quote: We found that CsChrimson activation of DNp09 neurons was sufficient to trigger freezing in 61.5% (492/800) of trials.
mapping_basis: Paper name DNp09 is a MANC type name, but the kit lists DNp09 also as a hemibrain synonym of DNp71 and driver_lines.csv marks SS01540 AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71); the paper's Namiki DNp09 anatomy supports DNp09.
stimulation: 627 nm red LEDs, 0.025 mW/mm2, 10 repetitions of 2 s on / 20 s off
other_cell_types: weak off-target labeling (not named; paper refers to FlyLight)
notes: Freezing was preceded by a brief increase in walking speed caused by DNp09 ('This running bout was much reduced in control flies'); this is a speed change in already-moving flies, so under the freezing convention the legs are coded no. Jumps at light offset.

title: Female contact activates male-specific interneurons that trigger stereotypic courtship behavior in Drosophila

other fru-expressing neurons
notes: Paywalled, not in PMC; abstract only. Courtship initiation correlated with activation of P1, P2b or both in MARCM clones; abstract does not describe leg movements.

title: Control of walking direction by descending and dopaminergic neurons in Drosophila
quote: Activation drove consistent increases in forward walking speed,
mapping_basis: DNp17 is a MANC type name, but the kit also lists 'DNp17' as a synonym of DNut046 and driver_lines.csv marks SS02553 AMBIGUOUS (DNp17;DNut046); the paper names the DN DNp17.
stimulation: red light 0.4-4.1 mW/cm2, 9 trials per intensity
other_cell_types: DopaMeander (type 2, dopaminergic brain interneuron)
local brain interneurons (types 3, 4, 7)
ascending neurons (types 5, 8)
VNC local neuron (type 6)
notes: Increased locomotion scored from centroid tracking, no leg tracking. The paper attributes the walking phenotype to co-labelled DopaMeander, not DNp17 (Fig. 3).

title: Control of walking direction by descending and dopaminergic neurons in Drosophila
quote: Flies expressing CsChrimson in DNp17 displayed a broad range of forward velocities between 1 and 12 mm/s with a median of 5 mm/s.
mapping_basis: DNp17 is a MANC type name, but the kit also lists 'DNp17' as a synonym of DNut046 and driver_lines.csv marks SS02553 AMBIGUOUS (DNp17;DNut046); the paper names the DN DNp17.
stimulation: red light, up to 4.1 mW/cm2 (data averaged over 9 trials at 4.1 mW/cm2)
other_cell_types: DopaMeander (type 2) in some flies
other SS02553 types (local brain interneurons, ascending neurons, VNC local neuron) in some flies
n_flies_note: 26 SPARC flies in total (17 with partial expression, 9 none); number with DNp17 but not DopaMeander not reported
notes: Flies labelled in DNp17 without DopaMeander walked slower than those with DopaMeander; no statistical comparison with no-expression flies ('very low average forward velocities') is reported.

title: Fine-grained descending control of steering in walking Drosophila
